previous_statement: For every finite integer d, every nonempty subset S of the positive integers satisfying m <= d for every m in S is contained in the finite set {1,...,d} and therefore has a maximum.
new_statement: For every finite nonnegative integer d, every nonempty set S of integers m occurring as dimensions m=dim_C(C^m) and satisfying m<=d is contained in the finite set {0,...,d}; therefore S has a maximum.
